baseline.method: AST loads immutable original _hold_missing_current_support into the same class. Both actual producer pixel-processing positive cases emit unqualified unavailable instead of the station identity-only envelope; no original source file is modified.

cause: GEN19 support absence recovered 0.268 s later within the old 0.8 s geometry deadline, but producer dropped the enrolled station parent and emitted generic unavailable. Task and remote rejected this unqualified notification as target loss.
change: After existing support absence/conflict/source checks, a locally registered stationary producer emits the existing typed station envelope plus a strictly bound short support-gap receipt. Consumers withdraw geometry, preserve identity only until the minimum original geometry/identity/phase/session deadline and original monotonic cap, and require complete fresh support/RGB/identity recovery with a three-topic join. Initial unregistered support handling is unchanged.
limitations: Original GEN19 messages and metadata are preserved byte-for-byte. Actual GEN19 terminated before next READY and did not perform the new successful recovery join.

End-to-end producer tests use synthetic RGB-D and ROS transport with actual segmentation, support/RGB verification, station registration, callbacks and joins. They prove the software handoff, not physical grasp.

No support threshold, 0.8 s cap, collision check, actuator limit, phase/session deadline or motion authorization is relaxed. New valid current measurements subsequently use original fresh-measurement contracts; expired gap authority cannot be revived.
